strategy_roster.name: Supertrend Distance Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: Supertrend is unavailable; the documented 20-bar lookback is represented by a prior-high breakout and midpoint reversion. The 10/3/2 Supertrend and deviation parameters, stop, and short side are not expressible as this long DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Parabolic SAR Distance Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: Parabolic SAR is unavailable, so EMA(20) is an explicit direction proxy using the documented lookback period. Acceleration 0.02/0.2, the deviation band, price-step stop, and short side are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Williams R Slope Mean Reversion
strategy_roster.notes: Williams %R and slope are unavailable; RSI(14) oversold recross within the documented 20-bar lookback proxies the reversal, with RSI(14)>50 as balance. The documented 2% stop is retained.

strategy_roster.name: Color JLaguerre
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) is the permitted proxy for the unavailable Laguerre color oscillator, preserving the documented middle 50 and high 85 levels. A bearish recross exits; the documented 2% stop is retained and the short side is omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Forex Fraus Portfolio
strategy_roster.notes: Williams %R is unavailable, so RSI(14) crossing above the standard oversold proxy 30 represents the long re-entry and RSI>70 the opposite extreme exit. WPR period, thresholds, session limits, and point-based protection have no documented numeric defaults here.

strategy_roster.name: X2MA JJRSX
strategy_roster.notes: The documented fast/slow MA values 12/5 and RSI(8) 30/70 thresholds are retained on the available series. The 4h/30m split and long-only schema omit higher-timeframe evaluation; no stop is documented.

strategy_roster.name: Parabolic SAR EA
strategy_roster.notes: Parabolic SAR reversals are unavailable, so bullish and bearish EMA(20) crosses are explicit direction proxies. The 0.02/0.2 SAR settings and 50-pip stop/target are absolute-price protections, not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Conditional Position Opener
strategy_roster.notes: This manual-switch strategy has no documented indicator entry and defaults both EnableBuy and EnableSell to false; the impossible positive-price guard avoids fabricating orders. Position state and 100/200-pip protection are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Glam Trader (Multi-timeframe Confirmation)
strategy_roster.notes: The documented EMA(3) bias is approximated with EMA(20) on the available series and positive ROC for the unavailable Laguerre/Awesome confirmations. The three timeframes, gamma, and point-based stops/targets/trailing are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: EXP FIBO ZZ
strategy_roster.notes: ZigZag is unavailable; the documented depth 12 is approximated by a prior 12-bar high breakout and opposite prior-low exit. The 5/20/100-pip corridor limits, 61.8/161.8 Fibonacci protection, session, and break-even logic are unsupported.
